title: A hierarchy of edge-weight symmetries in perfect matchings
summary: Motivated by the exact weight perfect matching problem and recent parameterized algorithms for finding an $\ell$-th smallest perfect matching, we study structural properties of edge-weight symmetries in graphs. Recent work by El Maalouly et al. (ESA 2025) showed that excluding all perfect matchings whose weight is at most the $(\ell - 1)$-th smallest possible value in the graph requires fixing at most $2(\ell-1)$ edges in non-bipartite graphs and at most $\ell-1$ edges in bipartite graphs.
